routes.text: Buy an additional Mod Config slot for 10 Platinum after reaching Mastery Rank 10.

source.quote: '''Configurations''' - Seen at the top-middle of the Upgrade screen are three '''Config''' tabs. These allow for saving different presets of equipped Mods for greater customization and faster swapping between builds. It’s important to note that all Configs share the same Polarities in their respective Mod Slots, which means changing one with {{Resource|Forma}} will affect that Mod Slot in all Configs. However, for Abilities added onto Warframes via the [[Helminth#Ability Replacement|Helminth system]], these can be saved to individual Configs. Tabbing between Configs with different Mods slotted in will adjust the Stats Summary to show potential value changes. More Configs can be purchased for {{Pc|10}} when the player has reached Mastery Rank 10, up to a total of six. The arrangement of Configs can be swapped around by holding {{Keybind|LMB}}and dragging it over to the other Config the player wants to swap with.

routes.text: Complete Nightwave daily and weekly challenges to earn Nightwave Standing.

source.quote: The Nightwave system consists of daily and weekly challenges that players can complete to earn Nightwave {{Sc|Standing}}, which is used to rank up through Nightwave's 30 ranks (15 during Intermission I), with each level requiring {{sc|10,000}} to level up. Every rank attained grants unique rewards, with rarer rewards being available at higher ranks, which include so-called {{Nc|Creds}} (not to be confused with {{Resource|Credits}}), a special Series-specific currency that can be spent in Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Note that any duplicate Nightwave-exclusive rewards will be converted to {{Nc|50}}. Each series introduces a different issue of {{Nc|Creds}} that can only be spent on merchandise during its own series. Note that unlike other [[Syndicate]] {{Sc|Standing}}, Nightwave Standing is only used to increase Nightwave ranking but cannot be used to buy any Syndicate-specific merchandise (which instead is done for {{Nc|Creds}}), with any leftover Standing upon ranking up carried over towards the next ranking up.
